current.text: Experts expect him to come off the bench this season, even with Jusuf Nurkic hurt.
Jusuf Nurkic is hurt. In the preseason Jaxson Hayes started at center, because Utah does not want Jaren Jackson Jr. playing much center.
He is expected to play about 30 minutes a game as a bench player. He has looked good in the preseason.
He is expected to be part of the closing lineup.
Most of his good production last season came late in the year, when Utah sat its veterans.
Experts say his late-season numbers will not repeat. Utah is healthy, is trying to win and is not expected to tank, so those minutes will not be there.
Utah has a crowded roster. Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr., Keyonte George and Darryn Peterson all take usage.
Experts see him only as a last-round flyer outside the top 120. He is tier 8 in category leagues and is overdrafted at a 3 USD auction price.
When Darryn Peterson and Lauri Markkanen sit, the offense should run through him and his stats could rise.
He is the number two prospect in the organization and could take Keyonte George's place as the secondary scorer within a year.

durable.text: His category line has no real outlier. Threes are his best category. FG% and assists are his weakest, but only mildly.
He is worth more in points leagues than in category leagues.
